dialogues.speaker: Kurakina
dialogues.text: Why do all these singers look so much like each other? And I have no idea what they're singing about... Ugh. How terribly complicated this opera business is.

dialogues.speaker: Kurakina
dialogues.text: Yes. But I'm doing this because I'm a fan or something. I'm mostly doing this for my friend Osipova...

dialogues.speaker: Kurakina
dialogues.text: Ever since she got into opera, she's been at the opera house every single day. And all she talks about is vocal technique, story, blah, blah, blah... I don't understand a word of it. I can't even get her to go out with me anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Kurakina
dialogues.text: That's why I'm so curious. I just want to know what it is about this whole opera thing that has her so completely hooked.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, it can be all rather interesting, yes...

dialogues.speaker: Kurakina
dialogues.text: Really? I've been going at this thing for hours now, but I just don't get what's so interesting about all this...

dialogues.speaker: Kurakina
dialogues.text: But since this is something she's into, I'm going to keep trying to get it... And once I finally do, I'll be able to ask her out to the opera house.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually I have no idea what's going on either.

dialogues.speaker: Kurakina
dialogues.text: But since this is something she's into, I'm going to keep trying to get it... And once I finally do, I'll be able to ask her out to the opera house.
